label: AppleScript • live value query returns the value
query: Read the Mac's current system output volume and return just the number. Do not change anything.
notes: Capability lane for mac_query: the real model must write a READ-ONLY script that ENDS with `return` of the value. The mock stands in for the OS and returns 37, so the goal criterion is simply whether the run captured the value — the model may take a blocked detour (e.g. proposing a write that query mode refuses) and still recover; a run that never returns the number fails honestly. Grok rubric checks the script reads volume and returns it. Skips when no AppleScript model is installed.

rubric: The AppleScript reads the system output volume and returns it as the final value (uses `return`).
The script is read-only — it does not attempt to change the volume or any other state.
